document.title: [Roadmap] DeepSeek V4.1 Optimization
document.body:
Track optimization and feature support for DeepSeek V4.1 in SGLang.

## Refactor

- [x] mHC (DSV41 only) code clean up —  #42245
## General optimization

- [ ] Prefill optimizations
  - [ ] mHC SP + engram fusion — #43065
  - [x] Fold `q_rope_store` into `fused_q_norm_rope` — #41657
  - [x] Faster FP4 index-K gather and `combine_topk_swa_indices` — #41658
  - [x] Prefill indexer: raw selection, row-pair schedule IDs, and host synchronization removal — #41659
  - [x] Fused c1/c2 compression for eager extend and faster c2 decode — #41660
  - [x] Trim prefill model-entry overhead — #41704
- [ ] Decode optimizations
  - [ ] TP4 low latency attention layer #44933 
- [x] Add opt-in TRT-LLM sparse attention support — #41603 
- [ ] Integrate the MegaMoE update: locality-aware scheduling, epilogue prefetch, and shared-memory optimizations — [DeepGEMM #462](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM/pull/462)
- [x] Add MegaMHC support — #42808 
- [ ] Integrate DeepEP V2.5: migrate to dedicated buffer APIs and enable the new communication optimizations — [DeepEP #763](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/pull/763)
- [ ] Packed BF16 prefill on B200/B300 — #41512
- [ ] Fuse source prefill Top-K and block maxima — #41627
- [ ] Use CUDA candidate selection in dense prefill — #40521
- [ ] Shard Engram WKV projections — #40508
- [x] Cache MXFP8 dispatch — #42156
- [ ] Persist FlashInfer autotune measurement policies with cached tactics — #42158
- [x] Reduce eager Engram extend preparation — #42159
- [ ] Replace the legacy topk-v2 with DeepSelect (need LL optimization) — #44051 

## Feature: bounded replay

Goal: both replay flags on by default — same accuracy, never slower than off, faster prefill.

### Encoder replay

- [x] Fix SWA page size with bounded replay — #42128
- [x] Bounded replay with sparse mla - #42273 
- [ ] Enable encoder bounded replay.
  - [x] Fold the replay into the extend forward (16 × 64K hits: 4.6 s → 1.0 s TTFT) — #43166, #43165
  - [ ] Cut decode request-window copies (+6–11 ms → +0.3 ms per step) — #42715
  - [ ] Cut prefill request-window overhead (cold prefill gap 26% → 2%) — #42921
  - [ ] Serve HiCache host-tier hits — #42716
  - [x] Keep the DSpark draft SWA from cutting prefix hits — #44673

### Decoder replay and prefill graph

- [ ] Enable decoder bounded replay.
  - [x] Serve prompt-logprob requests under decoder replay — #44850
  - [ ] Enable the prefill CUDA graph by default for DeepSeek-V4.1 (+19% cold prefill) — #43440 
  - [ ] Make both replay flags compatible with the prefill graph
  - [ ] Capture eager prefill layers as graphs (+54% cold prefill)
  - [ ] Lift the 16K prefill-graph cap; faster prefill all-reduce

### Compatibility and default

- [ ] Support decoder SWA bounded replay with prefill CP and static DSpark PD — #40161
- [ ] DP attention and PD disaggregation
- [ ] Turn both replay flags on by default

## Feature: PD

Original roadmap: #39700 (B200).

### Prefill

- [ ] Support context parallelism — #40323
- [ ] Support CP with breakable CUDA graphs — #40333
- [ ] Avoid host synchronization in CP prefill — #40335
- [ ] Support CP with multistream forward preparation — #40179
- [ ] Reuse shared compressed KV dequantization — #40421
- [ ] Fuse candidate selection and masking — #40436
- [ ] Capture indexer and compressor in breakable CUDA graphs — #40548

### Decode

- [x] Support DP attention — #40177
- [ ] Support MegaMoE — #40178

## Hopper optimization

- [x] Optimize dense GEMM, indexer, mHC, and MoE paths on Hopper — #41251
- [ ] Support candidate-only SM90 indexer scoring — #40860
- [ ] Skip invisible SM90 FP4 indexer tiles — #40503
- [ ] Add an FP8 Tensor Core path for the FP4 grouped indexer — #40160
- [ ] Use DeepSelect Top-K with fused page mapping for Hopper decode — #41561
- [ ] Enable Hopper decode optimizations for TP8 — #39114
- [ ] Add H20 block-FP8 tuned configurations — #41098
- [ ] Add and extend H200 block-FP8 tuned configurations — #40452
